newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures mixed as firm sterling hits gains.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures mixed as firm sterling hits gains.

text.p: LIFFE UK wheat futures ended mixed as a firmer sterling countered earlier price rises triggered by increased export optimism, traders said.
A lack of fresh grain coming forward from farms helped bolster sentiment and improved prospects were underlined by the return of shipper interest, traders said.
But sterling's recovery against other European currencies this afternoon offset the rise. The market "would have stayed firm if the pound hadn't gone up a bit," one said.
Prices were likely to stay at current levels, around 100 stg for May, in the period up to Christmas, he said.
Last trades ranged between 0.60 lower and 0.50 higher. Active March last traded 0.15 stg lower at 98.20 stg per tonne, having seen a high of 98.50 stg earlier in the day.
Front month January last traded 0.15 stg higher at 95.90 stg, from a high of 96.50 stg.
Barley futures were unchanged to 0.35 stg higher. Active March was last traded 0.25 stg higher at 96.00 stg.
